title: Ticketing platform venue user and role export

title: Ticketing platform security settings export

title: IT help desk onboarding and termination tickets, July 2025 to June 2026

title: Endpoint management console export

title: Anti-malware console settings
what_it_shows: Definitions update daily; alerts are sent to a shared mailbox with no one assigned to read it; users with local admin rights can pause protection

title: Ticket scanner device list

title: Firewall interface and segment list

title: Wi-Fi controller export

title: Log, audit and time settings review
source_system: Ticketing platform, identity provider, cloud console, firewall and PC settings
what_it_shows: Ticketing venue audit log kept 90 days; identity provider sign-in logs and cloud audit logs at default retention; PCs keep default Windows logs; firewall logs stay on the device; no log forwarding or review schedule configured; sample ticketing and identity provider entries record user, time, action and source address; local administrators can clear PC logs; PCs sync to a public time source and the firewall clock is set manually

title: Cloud resource inventory, IAM and security settings export
what_it_shows: Patron marketing database (nightly copy of about 260,000 patron records, no card data fields), show settlement web app (built by a contractor in 2023), nightly export function, object storage for exports and settlement files, and backup vault, all in one account and region; 2 named cloud administrators sign in through the identity provider; no standing access for the settlement app contractor; storage encrypted at rest; database reachable only through private endpoints; settlement app set to HTTPS only behind single sign-on; no inbound management ports; no account-level block on public object storage (per-bucket defaults); no key vault in use

title: Backup job reports, April to June 2026
what_it_shows: Daily backups of the patron marketing database and the settlement app completed; backup vault immutability off; no restore jobs in the period

title: Cloud provider SOC 2 report and shared responsibility documentation
what_it_shows: Provider SOC 2 report and the published shared responsibility description for the services in use

what_it_shows: Classifies the company as a Visa Level 3 merchant; sets SAQ D for Merchants for MID-T and SAQ P2PE for MID-F, an AOC for each account, and quarterly ASV scans for MID-T, all due 2026-12-15; states the acquirer will consider SAQ A plus SAQ P2PE for MID-T once box office and phone orders move to a validated P2PE solution and the online checkout meets the SAQ A eligibility criteria

title: 2025 SAQs and AOCs
what_it_shows: MID-T was validated for 2025 with SAQ A and MID-F with SAQ P2PE, both signed by the majority owner; the MID-T SAQ A describes the online channel only

title: Merchant agreement
what_it_shows: Two merchant accounts (MID-T and MID-F) with the same acquiring bank; requires PCI DSS compliance; requires notice to the acquirer within 24 hours of a suspected card data compromise (fictional term)

title: Acquirer merchant statements, July 2025 to June 2026
what_it_shows: About 610,000 card transactions: MID-T about 150,000 online orders, about 16,000 box office card-present sales and about 5,000 phone orders; MID-F about 440,000 card-present sales; Visa about 335,000; ticket revenue settles daily to the company's bank through the ticketing vendor's payment partner

title: Ticketing vendor SOC 2 Type 2 report
what_it_shows: Type 2 report on Security, Availability and Confidentiality for the 12 months ending 2026-03-31; the system description covers the marketing settings feature and the dynamic pricing and bot mitigation modules, states RTO 4 hours and RPO 15 minutes and a 72-hour customer incident notice, and carves out the cloud host and the payment partner; complementary user entity controls are listed

title: Payment partner AOC and box office reader documentation
source_system: Controller's vendor files; payment partner documentation
what_it_shows: The payment partner AOC on file is dated 2024-04-30; the 4 USB box office card readers encrypt card data at read and are not part of a PCI-listed validated P2PE solution; the partner offers a validated P2PE option with standalone devices that also accept key-entered phone orders

title: POS vendor device list and P2PE solution listing
source_system: POS vendor back office (SYS-03); PCI SSC list of validated P2PE solutions
what_it_shows: 38 P2PE card readers listed (26 fixed at bars and stands, 12 handheld); the solution appears on the PCI SSC list of validated P2PE solutions; manual card entry disabled; one clerk login per bar; the device list was last reconciled with the venue in 2024; no reader inspection records were provided

source_system: Box office and bar POS receipts

title: Dynamic pricing and bot mitigation module settings and change history
what_it_shows: Dynamic pricing was switched on in March 2026 by a ticketing administrator, in auto-apply mode, for reserved-seat Hall shows only (46 shows since March 2026), with no per-show floor or ceiling entered; bot mitigation and the virtual queue run on on-sales marked high demand (14 in the last 12 months); the purchase limit of 6 is enforced per account with no linked-account check; the vendor keeps session records 30 days; no block or false-positive report is scheduled

what_it_shows: The only security document returned is the 2022 one-page acceptable use form; the request for security policies, an incident response plan, a PCI DSS scope document, a network or card data flow diagram, configuration and change procedures, a data retention schedule, a list of service providers with their PCI DSS responsibilities, card reader inspection logs, an event-day manual entry procedure, and a review record for the dynamic pricing module returned none

title: Integrator PC disposal certificates
what_it_shows: Wipe certificates for the 2 PCs retired in 2026

title: Control assessment: Log review interviews

title: Control assessment: Sign-in test

source_system: Interviews (General Manager, Controller, IT Manager, Director of Ticketing); incident notes from a 2025 lost scanner; draft POL-03

title: Control assessment: Staff reporting interviews

what_it_shows: No required reporting time; 3 of 8 staff would report within the hour; no defined recipients; nobody knew the acquirer's 24-hour notice term

title: Control assessment: Media sanitization review
source_system: Phone-order binder; integrator PC disposal certificates (2 PCs retired in 2026); box office walk-through

title: Control assessment: Vulnerability management interview
source_system: IT Manager interview; no scan reports exist
what_it_shows: No vulnerability monitoring or scanning, internal or ASV

source_system: Ticketing contract; vendor AOC 2026-02-20 and SOC 2; payment partner AOC 2024; agency and integrator contracts
what_it_shows: The ticketing contract requires PCI DSS compliance and the vendor AOC and SOC 2 report are current; the agency contract has no privacy or data-use terms; no breach notice time is required of the ticketing vendor or the agency; external service oversight is not defined; the payment partner AOC on file is from 2024 with no annual check

title: Control assessment: Boundary protection test
source_system: Firewall export 2026-07-15; traffic test from a production-segment laptop and from a box office PC 2026-08-05
what_it_shows: Inbound traffic denied by default and all external connections pass through the firewall; guest Wi-Fi internet only; a production-segment laptop reached the corporate segment on 2 ports and a corporate PC reached the CCTV recorder; box office PCs on the corporate segment; no monitoring of external or internal traffic

title: Control assessment: Malicious code protection test
source_system: Anti-malware console; test file (industry test string) on 2 box office PCs 2026-08-05
what_it_shows: The test file was detected and quarantined on both PCs; the alert went to an unmonitored mailbox; users with local admin can pause protection; false positives are not tracked

title: Control assessment: Checkout integrity review
source_system: Checkout page captures 2026-07-21 and 2026-08-05; vendor responsibility matrix; Marketing Director interview
